notes.title: Demo Wrapped Up – More to Come!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
The demo is now offline, and we just want to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone who tried it out! We really appreciate the support, and this isn’t the last you’ll see of it—keep an eye out for the next demo coming later on! In the meantime, follow us on our socials to stay updated. See you soon! <3

notes.title: Seagulls: Crappy Situation Demo – Coming to Steam Couch Co-op Fest! 🚨
notes.content:
[h2][b]🚨 Get Ready for the Seagulls: Crappy Situation Demo – Coming to Steam Couch Co-op Fest! 🚨[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921895/cc4bfe56a26942f30d1dc2f5484de6bcaa56fa1c.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that Seagulls: Crappy Situation will be participating in the Steam Couch Co-op Fest from February 10th - 17th, 2025! 🎮

Don’t miss the chance to experience the chaos of this action-packed wave shooter in the demo version. This limited-time demo is packed with exciting features, including:

    Wave-based combat: Battle waves of seagulls with different classes, including tank-like birds and bomb planters.
    Raft expansion: Defend, clean, and expand your raft while surviving the storm of attacks!
    Comedic game play: Enjoy a fun and chaotic atmosphere as you fend off seagulls in this lighthearted survival adventure.
    Underwater exploration: Discover hidden collectibles beneath the waves that might just save your raft when you need it most.

[b]When?[/b]
📅 Steam Couch Co-op Fest runs from February 10th to 17th, 2025! During this event, the demo will be available for a limited time, so don’t miss out on your chance to dive in and experience the madness firsthand. ⏳

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
This demo includes just the core features available at launch, with much more to come in the full game. Make sure to follow us for more updates and news, and stay tuned for the full release!

👉 Add Seagulls: Crappy Situation to your wishlist and don’t miss out on the Steam Couch Co-op Fest! See you on the waves! 🌊

notes.title: Comic Con Stockholm 2024
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that we’ll be at Comic Con in Stockholm this year! Join us from November 1-3 at Booth F:20 as we showcase our latest work and connect with all of you!

This is a fantastic opportunity to experience our game firsthand, meet the team, and dive into our creative journey. Come say hi! We can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on and gather your feedback! See you there! 🚀
